verdict.rationale: Publishing llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question for any service with public web documentation, so the axis applies. The evidence pack only contains human-oriented web guidance on incorporation steps, fees and filing channels, with no llms.txt or agent-oriented documentation. The keyless CKAN JSON probe belongs to the separate national open-data portal, not the registry, and is an API rather than agent docs, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
